name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one value from a list of five or more options.
a11y: Trigger is role=combobox with aria-expanded; the list is role=listbox with option items.
Arrow keys, Home, End and type-ahead move; Enter selects; Escape closes.
Inside a Field it is labelled by the Field's label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. An empty string shows the placeholder.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen item's value.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the value is submitted through a hidden input.

props.name: children
props.description: The parts of the component: a trigger and its content.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button, Input and Select at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). A surrounding Field sets this from its `error`.

props.name: position
props.description: Accepted for compatibility with earlier versions; the list is always positioned against the trigger.

props.name: value
props.description: The value reported by `onValueChange` when this item is chosen. Must be non-empty.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the item unselectable and skipped by the keyboard.

usage: import {Field, Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectTrigger, SelectValue} from '@monoline/react';
